fuel_consumption.source_quote: Projected 2009 fuel requirements implied ~354M gal (32.2M gal / 9.1% = ~354M gal), derived from item7a disclosure that 32.2M gal covers 9.1% of 2009 projected requirements.

instrument_type_details.notes: Instruments include: jet fuel swap arrangements (pay fixed/receive floating Gulf Coast jet fuel), collars, purchased call options, sold call options. Commodities: jet fuel, heating oil, or crude oil. Sold calls and crude oil derivatives did not qualify for hedge accounting. Net fair value -$65.5M (Level 3 liability at Dec 31, 2008). Large 2008 loss: $150.8M non-operating derivative loss including $126.3M realized losses ($109M from unwinding 2009 contracts prematurely). By Feb 2, 2009 (subsequent): increased to 116.0M gal (32.5% of 2009) + 17.3M gal (4.9% of 2010). Effective Jan 1, 2009, ceased designating fuel derivatives as hedge accounting instruments.

warnings: Net fair value -$65.5M (liability) at Dec 31, 2008 per Level 3 fair value reconciliation in item8 notes.
2008 non-operating derivative loss of $150.8M including $126.3M realized losses ($109M from unwinding 2009 hedges early); additional $41.2M cash settled in early 2009.
Effective Jan 1, 2009, ceased hedge accounting designation for all fuel derivatives.
